name: Reading uploaded documents
summary: Pull the text out of a PDF or Word file somebody uploaded, and say plainly when it cannot be done.

provenance.source: SimpleHire — its CV parsing, in particular the hard-won handling of scanned PDFs that contain no text at all
provenance.changes: Reduced to text extraction with no domain parsing, and given a single entry point that decides the format from the file's own bytes rather than its name.

postInstall: Call extractText() with the uploaded file. Check the `ok` field before using the text — a scanned document has none.
limitations: It reads text that is already text. A scanned page is a picture of words, and this returns nothing for it — it says so rather than returning an empty string.
No OCR. If you need to read scans, that is a paid service and a separate decision.
It gives you the words, not the meaning. Working out which bit is somebody's phone number is your job.
Old .doc files (Word 97) are not supported. Only .docx.

pull text from a Word document somebody uploaded
let candidates upload their CV and read it
